Source It has been close to two months since Bigg Boss went on air. The show is getting intense, and the contestants are leaving no stone unturned to stay in the house as long as possible and become top five finalists.
 Currently, there are 12 contestants in the house. A prediction is doing the rounds on social media regarding the five finalists of Bigg Boss 20.
 Going by the buzz on social media, Qazi Touqeer, Aisha Khan, Scoop Op, Gull, and Kanika Mann are the top five contestants of Bigg Boss 20. 
 These five participants are the most loved and popular contestants of the season.
